item.description: In gittuf before 0.18.0, verification of file protection rules uses the quoted, escaped pathnames that Git prints by default for files with special characters (for example non-ASCII characters) instead of the raw paths. Such paths do not match patter…

item.title: CVE-2026-123974 · 7.8 HIGH 👻 — pytorch/serve: Local privilege escalation through insecure temporary path
item.description: In all versions of PyTorch's TorchServe, a predictable extraction directory in /tmp lets a local user swap the model handler and run code as the TorchServe service account leading to local privilege escalation.
